_README: LOCAL STACK ONLY. The entry below talks to the compose worker over plaintext h2c on localhost.
`--insecure` forces a plaintext channel and OVERRIDES --tls/--ca, so it must be removed before this is
pointed at anything but localhost. JSON has no comments; the deployed form is spelled out in _DEPLOYED below.

_DEPLOYED._why: Through a cloud load balancer: TLS on, the LB's CA pinned, and the group/zone metadata the LB routes on.
_notes: Drop --ca only when the load balancer serves a certificate your system trust store already has.
Never keep --insecure in a deployed entry: it silently downgrades the hop to plaintext.
The key is a group MCP key (rmk_), minted on the group page. rmn_ API keys are refused by workers.
